about.intro: PT Usaha Bersama Gemilang serves industrial and event catering needs from West Cikarang, Bekasi Regency. We believe good food begins with thoughtful processes and people who care.
about.directorMessage: Every portion comes with responsibility. We aim to be a partner who is easy to talk to, understands your operations, and keeps learning to improve our service. Thank you for giving us the opportunity to grow together.
about.vision: To be a catering partner trusted for the quality of our food, service, and attention to our customers.

privacy.title:
Necessary data.
A clear purpose.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how data is used when you contact PT Usaha Bersama Gemilang.

sections.title: Data and purpose
sections.body: Your name, company, email, phone, service requirements, portion estimate, and message are used to respond to your quotation request with your consent. Please do not include sensitive information.

sections.title: Processing and providers
sections.body: The website does not store form submissions in a database or CMS. Enquiries are forwarded through an email provider. Hosting, anti-bot, email, and security services may process technical metadata, including outside Indonesia. The company must review provider retention and agreements before launch.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Under Indonesia’s Personal Data Protection Law No. 27 of 2022, you may request access, correction, deletion, or withdrawal of consent by contacting info@ubg.id. Requests are handled following proportionate verification and applicable legal obligations.

sections.title: Retention and contact
sections.body: Emails are retained only as needed for follow-up and legal obligations. The company must approve a final retention schedule. Contact info@ubg.id for privacy enquiries.
